messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: Control-plane heartbeat silence detected for region eu-central3. 98% of gpu-nodes unreachable, control-plane API 503s, customer error rate spike >90%. Auto-failover did not trigger (health-check timeout).
megan: Ack. Creating #incident-eu-central3 and paging infra oncall. Tagging leads.
oncall-bot: Paging aditya (oncall) — incident channel created: #incident-eu-central3.
aditya: I’m on it. First pass — is this control-plane only or data-plane too?
monitoring-bot: API endpoints show 503/504. BGP/infra metrics: upstream fabric reports partial packet loss between region edge routers and control-plane. Workload agents show node heartbeats absent.
lena: Quick check: dedicated pools in eu-central3 report node kubelet not responding. Dedicated customers likely impacted. Private deployments may be unaffected (they're VPC controlled) — need confirmation.
charles: Running quick probes from us-west1 to region gateways:
```
$ curl -s -D - https://eu-central3-api.redwood.internal/health | head -n 10
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: 8f3a2b
X-Region: eu-central3
{"status":"control-plane-unavailable"}
```
charles: Control-plane is returning 503s. Traceroute shows hang at the region edge (AS path stops at eu-cent-edge-01).
aditya: Ok — next steps from runbook: 1) Confirm failover targets, 2) open cloud provider ticket, 3) shift traffic by policy to fallback regions (eu-west1 primary fallback, then us-west1).
aditya: @ops-bot can you start the routing policy change (failover) and estimate expected RPS per fallback cluster?
ops-bot: Routing policy update initiated: switching 80% traffic from eu-central3 -> eu-west1, 20% -> us-west1. Estimated increase: eu-west1 +60% RPS, us-west1 +25% RPS. This will increase infra spend; estimate additional GPU-hours ~45 GPU-hrs/hr for the next 2 hours.
megan: Do it. Prioritize low-latency customers to eu-west1. Support, prepare status message to customers and docs.
support: Drafting status page update. Quick note: Dedicated customers in eu-central3 will see degraded or no inference; contacting committed accounts now.
lena: Aditya — verify Dedicated reserved pools can accept burst from eu-central3. If not, start cold instance spin-up in eu-west1.
aditya: Checking pool capacity...
aditya: capacity-check output:
```
available_gpus_eu-west1: 120 (35% reserved but can be preempted with notice)
available_gpus_us-west1: 48
current_request_backlog_eu-west1: 14
```
aditya: eu-west1 has headroom but we should spin 20 smaller instances to handle burst and reduce queue. Launching now.
charles: Provider console shows a networking event in eu-central3: "transit gateway: partial outage". I’m opening a high-priority ticket with the provider and requesting network engineering.
aditya: Also enabling aggressive KV cache fallback to reduce load; setting prefix cache TTL to 30m for affected routes.
lena: Are scheduled rollouts impacted? Suggest pausing any canaries in eu-central3.
aditya: Pausing all canaries and auto-rollouts in eu-central3.
megan: Who's owning customer comms? Support will post to status and notify SLAs. Also create a short internal summary for Sales/CS.
support: Posting initial status: "We are investigating a control-plane outage in eu-central3 causing elevated error rates and routing degradations. Traffic is being shifted to eu-west1 and us-west1. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
charles: Provider responded to ticket: "Transit gateway incident acknowledged, team investigating a misconfiguration after maintenance window. ETA 45-90 minutes."
aditya: Timeline: failover in progress, spin-up in eu-west1 started, expected mitigation in 10-15 minutes for user impact. If provider fix takes >60m we keep shifted traffic and cap burst autoscaling to control cost.
megan: Cost note — expected additional spend ~ $2.2k/hr if failover persists at current scale. Finance notified.
aditya: Quick mitigation checklist done:
- routing policy: updated
- canaries paused
- dedicated pool burst spin-up initiated
- KV cache TTL decreased
- provider ticket opened
- status page live
- oncall rotation notified

I'll keep the channel updated with logs and provider updates.
lena: If provider confirms misconfig, request routing reconfiguration and a postmortem.
aditya: Agreed. Assigning postmortem owner: charles (network lead).
megan: Thanks all. Triage ongoing — next update in 10. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
